Ali Alipour.note: What separates Alipour is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Alipour arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Away from that action, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ali Alipour.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Ali Alipour踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ali Nemati.summary: Ali Nemati is an IR Iran centre-back from Foolad FC who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial cover, and back-line depth.
Ali Nemati.note: What separates Nemati is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Nemati checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. Also note how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ali Nemati.noteZh: Ali Nemati的比赛建立在球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动之上。首先看他如何在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。另一个方面是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Alireza Beiranvand.note: Beiranvand stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. In a separate phase, Beiranvand chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Alireza Beiranvand.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Alireza Beiranvand踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Alireza Jahanbakhsh.note: Watch Jahanbakhsh for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. The clearest example is how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. In a different phase, Jahanbakhsh slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Alireza Jahanbakhsh.noteZh: Alireza Jahanbakhsh最鲜明的特点是防线重组前制造干净射门。一个直接线索是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.summary: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh is an IR Iran forward from Tractor FC who gives the national team quick turns, final-third carrying, and attacking spark.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.note: The key to Hosseinzadeh is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Elsewhere in the game, Hosseinzadeh opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.noteZh: 理解Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Amirmohammad Razaghinia.summary: Amirmohammad Razzaghinia is an IR Iran central midfielder from Esteghlal FC who gives the national team midfield legs, duel pressure, and simple progression.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.note: Watch Razzaghinia for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also watch how Razzaghinia takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.noteZh: Amirmohammad Razzaghinia最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Arya Yousefi.summary: Arya Yousefi is an IR Iran right-back from Sepahan FC who gives the national team overlap timing, recovery defending, and right-side energy.
Arya Yousefi.note: Yousefi's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Arya Yousefi.noteZh: Arya Yousefi最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Danial Iri.summary: Danial Eiri is an IR Iran centre-back from Malavan Bandar Anzali who gives the national team centre-back depth, aerial defending, and box protection.
Danial Iri.note: For Eiri, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond that, watch how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Danial Iri.noteZh: Danial Eiri的优势在于先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。最直接的表现是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个值得观察的细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Dennis Dargahi.note: For Ayensa, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Beyond that, watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Dennis Dargahi.noteZh: 带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑构成Dennis Eckert Ayensa踢法的核心。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。除此之外，值得留意他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Ehsan Hajisafi.note: Hajsafi's signature is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Watch how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He also holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ehsan Hajisafi.noteZh: 最能体现Ehsan Hajsafi特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Hossein Hosseini.note: The key to Hosseini is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. One more thing to notice is how Hosseini leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Hossein Hosseini.noteZh: Hossein Hosseini的优势在于提前站位后的快速反应。最直接的表现是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个值得观察的细节是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Hossein Kanani.note: Kanaanizadegan stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Kanaanizadegan also meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Hossein Kanani.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Hossein Kanaanizadegan踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Mehdi Ghayedi.summary: Mehdi Ghayedi is an IR Iran winger from Al-Nasr SC who gives the national team low-centre turns, inside shots, and left-wing dribbling.
Mehdi Ghayedi.note: What separates Ghayedi is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Ghayedi draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. At another point, he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Mehdi Ghayedi.noteZh: Mehdi Ghayedi的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个值得观察的细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Mehdi Taremi.note: For Taremi, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Also watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Mehdi Taremi.noteZh: 比防线早一步看到决定性的传球是理解Mehdi Taremi踢法的关键。先看他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。到了另一个比赛环节，他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Mehdi Torabi.note: Watch Torabi for delivering the ball without needing much space. The clearest example is how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. Also watch how Torabi starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball.
Mehdi Torabi.noteZh: 很小空间里也能送出传中的能力构成Mahdi Torabi踢法的核心。他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。除此之外，值得留意他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。

Milad Mohammadi.note: For Mohammadi, the foundation is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. Look first at how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. Also watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Milad Mohammadi.noteZh: 最能体现Milad Mohammadi特点的是防线暴露后的回追速度。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。除此之外，他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Mohammad Ghorbani.summary: Mohammad Ghorbani is an IR Iran defensive midfielder from Al-Wahda FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and midfield size.
Mohammad Ghorbani.note: Watch Ghorbani for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also notice how Ghorbani holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Mohammad Ghorbani.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Mohammad Ghorbani踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mohammad Mohebbi.note: Mohebi stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. A different detail is how Mohebi shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Mohammad Mohebbi.noteZh: 看Mohammad Mehdi Mohebi的作用，关键是有目的地进行无球移动。他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Payam Niazmand.note: The key to Niazmand is command of the crowded space around goal. He attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. In another phase, Niazmand keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Payam Niazmand.noteZh: 最能体现Payam Niazmand特点的是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。这一点直接体现在他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。除此之外，他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Ramin Rezaeian.note: The key to Rezaeian is delivering the ball without needing much space. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. The next thing to watch is whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Ramin Rezaeian.noteZh: Ramin Rezaeian的比赛建立在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力之上。首先看他如何在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Roozbeh Cheshmi.note: Cheshmi stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. Also look at how Cheshmi changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Roozbeh Cheshmi.noteZh: Roozbeh Cheshmi的优势在于争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。最直接的表现是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。另一个值得观察的细节是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Saeid Ezatolahi.note: What separates Ezatolahi is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Ezatolahi uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Also note how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Saeid Ezatolahi.noteZh: Saeid Ezatolahi的比赛建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定之上。首先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Saleh Hardani.note: Hardani's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. At another point in the move, he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Saleh Hardani.noteZh: Saleh Hardani的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Saman Ghoddos.note: Ghoddos's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Away from that moment, he varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Saman Ghoddos.noteZh: 最能体现Saman Ghoddos特点的是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。这一点直接体现在他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。除此之外，他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Shahriyar Moghanloo.note: Moghanlou's signature is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Watch how he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. At another point in the move, he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Shahriyar Moghanloo.noteZh: 争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹是理解Shahriyar Moghanlou踢法的关键。先看他如何从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。到了另一个比赛环节，他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Shoja Khalilzadeh.note: The key to Khalilzadeh is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. One more thing to notice is how Khalilzadeh keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Shoja Khalilzadeh.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Shojae Khalilzadeh踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。
